name: Ascension
source:
What starts as a lighthearted adventure turns into a series of dark events and sinister secrets.

Can a group of mischievous brigands survive the mysteries surrounding the Old Kingdom, or will they die trying?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200306023111/https://rinmarugames.itch.io/rinmaru-ascension]the remake's official site[/url]]
translation:
一场起初轻松愉快的冒险，逐渐演变为一连串黑暗事件与险恶的秘密。

这群淘气的强盗，能够在围绕旧王国的谜团中幸存下来，还是会在探究的过程中丧命？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200306023111/https://rinmarugames.itch.io/rinmaru-ascension]重制版官方网站[/url]]
